Class CramReader

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.importers.BamReader
global.thalion.ttio.importers.CramReader
public class CramReader extends BamReader
CRAM importer — M88.

v1.5.0 swapped the samtools subprocess for htsjdk's pure-Java CRAM reader. Reference FASTA is still required (CRAM is reference- compressed). htsjdk's

invalid reference 
ReferenceSource
reads the FASTA at decode time to reconstitute the per-base data.

CRAM is the modern reference-compressed sequencing format used by the 1000 Genomes Project, GA4GH RefGet workflows, and clinical pipelines that need ~50% smaller files than BAM. The reference FASTA is a positional constructor argument; no env-var fallback, no RefGet HTTP support.

Cross-language equivalents: Python ttio.importers.cram.CramReader, Objective-C TTIOCramReader.

(M88, v1.5.0 htsjdk swap)

  • Constructor Details

    • CramReader

      public CramReader(Path path, Path referenceFasta)
      Construct a CramReader.
      Parameters:
      path - filesystem path to a CRAM file (no existence check until first BamReader.toGenomicRun(String) call).
      referenceFasta - filesystem path to the reference FASTA against which the CRAM was aligned. Required; CRAM is reference-compressed and cannot be decoded without it.

    • makeReaderFactory

      protected htsjdk.samtools.SamReaderFactory makeReaderFactory()
      Description copied from class: BamReader
      Build the htsjdk reader factory for this importer. Default is the lenient stringency factory suitable for SAM/BAM. CramReader overrides to inject a ReferenceSource so reference- compressed CRAM bytes can be reconstituted.
